title: The Diva Is Dismissed

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Make lettering interact with a face because the relationship can communicate performance and attitude.
strategic_value: Angled black text can animate the blue portrait while retaining the theater’s emphatic voice.
demonstration: A blue portrait occupies a yellow field with title, performer and engagement strips crossing at different angles.
practical_value: Compare diagonal text strips as a structure for both promotion and practical information.

content_islands.name: Portrait
content_islands.spec: Let the large blue head dominate the upper and central field.

content_islands.name: Text strips
content_islands.spec: Cross the lower face with title, performer and engagement lines, leaving the signature at upper right.

reference_purposes.Expression: A blue portrait occupies a yellow field with title, performer and engagement strips crossing at different angles.
